blockingIssues.description: app/analytics.tsx still uses grouped aggregates as if they were record counts: `analytics.harvestsByFarm.length` counts farms-with-harvests instead of harvest records, and `analytics.expensesByType.reduce((sum, _e) => sum + 1, 0)` counts expense categories instead of expense records, so the Activities Logged card and Category Breakdown still underreport filtered activity totals.

The analytics rerun still lacks locale entries for `analytics.labels.totalExpenses`, `analytics.labels.harvestYield`, and `analytics.sections.categoryBreakdown`, so the screen falls back to hardcoded English copy in non-English locales.

Completed tasks are dimmed twice: `app/tasks.tsx` wraps completed rows in `opacity: 0.8` while `src/components/cards/task-row.tsx` also applies `opacity: task.completed ? 0.8 : 1`, yielding an effective opacity near 0.64 instead of the required 0.8.

The redesigned attendance worker rows read from `workerAttendance`, but `loadAttendance()` still hydrates only the old single-worker `cellData` grid, so Full/Half/Absent pills do not reflect existing attendance records.

The new attendance row toggles and `handleMarkAllPresent()` mutate `workerAttendance`, but unsaved-change detection and persistence still run through `cellData`/`handleSave()`, so the redesigned worker-list interactions cannot actually save attendance changes.

The arrow date navigator only updates display state; real loading/saving still uses `rangeStart` / `dateRange`, and the old From/To date-range picker UI remains rendered, so the required arrow-based navigator is still cosmetic.

The new `Mark All Present` button lives inline inside the `ScrollView` and scrolls away, while the only bottom-anchored control remains the conditional save bar, so the required always-visible sticky CTA is still not implemented.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Require handoff `commitId` values to reference the actual landing commit for the feature being reported, or explicitly list any prerequisite/stacked commits when a follow-up fix depends on earlier changes.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Two rerun fix reports (`fix-analytics-data-integrity` and `fix-spray-catalog-cleanup`) recorded handoff `commitId: 6cba8cf`, but that commit only contains the earlier quick-win patch. Scrutiny had to review later repository state (`74b70d1` for spray cleanup and post-6cba8cf analytics changes) because the recorded commit did not reproduce the claimed feature changes.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add an explicit exception or escalation rule for follow-up fixes that require i18n, data-contract, or business-logic changes instead of pure visual restyling; such work should either use a different skill or document the allowed non-visual edits.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The failed `fix-analytics-data-integrity` task explicitly required adding locale keys and restoring truthful analytics totals, but `ui-worker` still instructs workers to avoid i18n and business-logic changes. The rerun landed partial approximations (grouped aggregate counts and missing locale keys) rather than a full fix.

rejectedObservations.observation: Repeated reports that `ui-worker` follow-up fix sessions did not evidence reading `AGENTS.md`, `.factory/library/architecture.md`, or both light/dark wireframes before editing.
rejectedObservations.reason: duplicate of the round-1 scrutiny recommendation already recorded in `.factory/validation/data-screens/scrutiny/synthesis.round1.json`; no new direct update was applied in this rerun.
